newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 30.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Wall Street, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 179.01 points to 6,962.03 on Tuesday, its second largest point rise ever, after benign economic data.
* U.S. stock gains could give Malaysian shares temporary relief. The Malaysian blue-chip Composite Index continued to ease, falling 15.35 points or 1.43 percent to 1,059.51.
* Ringgit weakened further, at 2.5118/28 a dollar at 0950 GMT on Tuesday.
* "People are still sidelined and very cautious," said Patrick Zecha, head of research at South Johor Securities. "It remains to be seen how well the market can stabilise."
* Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange president Salleh Majid urges institutional investors to return to the stock market which has been in a depression for past month.
* Leading stock broker Rashid Hussain Securities' head says weak investor sentiment will limit Malaysian stock market's upside in near-term despite earnings growth remaining intact.
* TA Enterprises, country's biggest retail stockbroker, reports year net profit at 247.40 million ringgit versus 199.90 million a year ago.
* Property, financial firm Talam Corp Bhd posts 59.33 million ringgit net profit in year, up from 38.66 million in corresponding period.
* Utility Tenaga Nasional says will reduce five billion ringgit annual capital spending by 20 percent.
